description: Revert one driftnet_move_items batch: every item goes back to the folder it came from, and items that had not been filed by hand are left to automatic sorting again. Use it right after a move the reader rejects; to put items somewhere else instead, call driftnet_move_items again. undo is the exact id a move returned; it is valid for 24 hours and only for the 20 most recent batches. It works once: a second call with the same id fails, so don't retry blindly. Fails if the id is unknown, expired or already used, or if a folder it needs was deleted since.

undo.description: The undo id returned by driftnet_move_items, as-is

name: driftnet_undo_move
title: Undo a batch move
